[Reuters: July US container imports hit fourth-highest on record, Descartes says](https://www.descartes.com/resources/news/reuters-july-us-container-imports-hit-fourth-highest-record-descartes-says)


Reuters highlights the latest Descartes July Global Shipping Report, which found that U.S. container imports reached their fourth-highest monthly total on record despite ongoing geopolitical and tariff uncertainty. The data points to continued resilience in global trade while underscoring the importance of visibility and analytics to help businesses navigate shifting trade policies and changing import patterns.

[Reuters: U.S. container imports fell 6.8% in January, but result points to more normalized trade, Descartes says](https://www.descartes.com/resources/news/reuters-us-container-imports-fell-68-january-result-points-more-normalized-trade)


U.S. container imports fell 6.8% in January, according to Descartes data cited by Reuters. While volumes declined month-over-month, the results point to more normalized trade patterns following extended periods of disruption and frontloading in early 2025. The data highlights how shifting demand, inventory adjustments, and trade policy dynamics continue to influence import activity in 2026.
